about: FoM(w0, wa) and FoM(Omega_m, 10^9 A_s) of the paper model (alpha_2 fixed at 0, sigma_v prior widths x6, pessimistic linear-bias prior) along the gap axis, over the same fit on the current pair list, with blocks of nuisance parameters held at the fiducial: all free, b1 per bin fixed, b1 residuals fixed (level, slope free), b1 level and slope fixed (residuals free), b2 bs2 fixed, a0 fixed, shot noise fixed, all nuisance fixed. Holding a block fixed deletes its rows and columns from the full Fisher matrix (data plus every prior) before the inversion. Row selection from each layout's largest derivative base (scripts/compute_pair_axes_fits.py); the "all free" ratios equal those of plots/pair_axes_gap. Written by notes/cross_correlations/plots/make_pair_axes_attribution_data.py from the attribution fits of scripts/compute_pair_axes_fits.py (chains/pair_axes_fits_<layout>.json). k_max is the z = 0 value of a per-bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i).
blocks: b1 level and slope fixed (residuals free)
